forecast_training: Only seasons earlier than predicted year. Surprise terms are zero for years with no publication or without a forecast for the actual winner. Other missing candidates receive neutral standardized surprise. Existing training pools and baseline features retained.
matched_pool: At least 13 actual PPG, original MIP pool, and published forecast. Baseline and variants use identical matched scoring pools.
full_pool: All original MIP candidates with at least 13 PPG; missing forecasts receive neutral standardized surprise.
warning: Recovered current copies of dated historical publications; independent opening-night snapshot verification unavailable. Very small test: only one then two prior usable expectation seasons. Forecast coverage incomplete, especially among lower-ranked candidates. No active model change.
